mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 5.7% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of a near-term monetary policy response, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: demand contraction with policy response expectation
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 in two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of a policy pivot toward stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above $440 billion combined with a stable or declining unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.6%) signals strong underlying demand and labor market resilience, which supports elevated corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 236.0 over two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which increases the probability of a restrictive monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 141,200 thousand and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightening with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below $440 billion combined with a drop in residential construction (HOUST) below 900 thousand signals a broad-based demand contraction, which increases the likelihood of a policy response, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: demand contraction with policy response expectation
